general news.headline: Live: After Abhijeet Dipke, Neha Bora detained as cops crack down on Tiranga YatraCJP Tiranga March Live Updates: Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP) 'Lehra Do Tiranga' protest in Delhi has taken a dramatic turn with founder Abhijeet Dipke and AISA President Neha Bora being taken into preventive custody ahead of the planned march at Connaught Place's Central Park. Welcome to our live coverage of the Cockroach Janta Party's (CJP's) Tiranga March protest at Connaught Place. We have Preeti Choudhury from India Today TV and Anand Singh from India Today Digital reporting live from the ground. I am Akshat Trivedi who will be updating you with the latest news on the march. The CJP has called for a 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march at Connaught Place's Central Park at 5 pm on Friday, with founder Abhijeet Dipke calling on people to wave the national flag amid the ongoing campaign demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

Before clock struck 5, Dipke was in custody. What happened ahead of Tiranga yatradramatic summary After hours of police pressure and paperwork, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke was detained within seconds of stepping out of his Delhi residence, hours before his planned 5 pm visit to Connaught Place's Central Park. Defying police orders citing prohibitory restrictions, Dipke questioned his detention, insisting he was neither protesting nor breaking any law, but merely carrying the Indian flag.
